text:
Nora (People Ops): Quick heads-up 5: we're piloting a Civic Engagement program: up to 5 paid civic days (voting, jury duty extension, verified volunteering) + an optional 1:1 donation match for eligible charities. Pilot regions: US/UK/DE. Draft policy lives here: https://handbook.internal.redwood/policies/civic-engagement-pilot-v1 :triangular_flag_on_post:

Felix (Payroll): Ok. Payroll needs a clear paycode and a taxability flag per country. For UK/DE we'll need guidance on whether the donation match is handled via payroll or as a separate non-pay vendor payment.

Gwen (Legal): I'll draft jurisdiction notes. DE likely needs works council notice if we treat donation match as a recurring benefit; also criminal background checks aren't relevant here but consent language for donations should be explicit.

Nora (People Ops): Flow: employee submits claim in portal -> manager attests (manager_id + note) -> employee e-signs policy ack when first claiming -> People Ops export captures ack and attestation. We want managers to be able to batch attest for recurring civic programs.

Alex (Hiring Ops): Also request an export column for hiring_manager / team so we can route manager nudges. Can we add an SLA flag when attestation >72h overdue?

Nora (People Ops): Yes to both. Proposed export fields: employee_id, country_code, claim_id, claim_type, days_requested, manager_id, manager_attested, attested_at, ack_required, ack_ts, payroll_paycode, payroll_taxable_flag, donation_match_amount, donation_vendor_id, hiring_manager, sla_alert.

train-bot: Microlearning assigned: "Civic Engagement Policy & Claim Process (12m)" to pilot-region employees. Due in 14 days.

Felix (Payroll): Example export/SQL for validation. Payroll will require sample CSV before first payroll run.

```
# CLI export
python hr_tools/export.py --export civic_engagement_claims --start 2026-10-01 --end 2026-10-31 --format csv > /tmp/civic_claims_oct.csv

# BigQuery
SELECT employee_id, country_code, claim_type, days_requested, manager_id, manager_attested, attested_at, ack_required, ack_ts, payroll_paycode, payroll_taxable_flag
FROM `redwood-hr.prod.civic_engagement_claims`
WHERE submitted_at BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31';
```

Gwen (Legal): I'll add the DE works council note + UK charity gift guidance by Wed. Also: require employees to upload donation receipt for match; define acceptable docs in the policy.

Raj (Benefits): We should add a short FAQ panel in the handbook clarifying statutory entitlements vs civic days so folks in statutory-heavy countries don't get confused. Also add a manager checklist item: "confirm event not company-sponsored" to avoid conflicts.

Nora (People Ops): Good point. We'll add that checklist bullet and a small manager widget for pending attestations in the portal (ETA: 2 sprints). We'll also require manager e-sign for the manager-side policy changes within 21 days of publish. People Ops will run weekly missing-ack exports.

i18n-team: We can localize EN->FR/DE/ES in ~4 business days after text freeze. Please mark placeholders like {policy_link}, {claim_deadline}.

Alex (Hiring Ops): Action items: 1) Gwen to deliver jurisdiction notes by Wed. 2) Felix to provide payroll paycode mapping and confirm vendor flow by Fri. 3) Eng to scope manager widget and batch-attest UX (2 sprints). 4) i18n to prep translations after freeze. 5) People Ops to publish pilot and upload initial sample export to payroll QA bucket.

Nora (People Ops): Final: we'll require first-time claimants to complete the 12m microlearning and e-sign before payment. People Ops will surface acks >30 days as compliance exceptions. I'll post the tracker sheet link and sample CSV in this thread once available. Thanks all :handshake:
